$comment: The Setup checklist (spec §15). One entry per deferrable item: who fills it, where the value lives, and which checks, tests, fixes and heartbeats it unblocks. scripts/preflight.ts writes a status per item into supabase/seed/setup.json; migration 0007 loads that into one.settings.setup; the Setup page (phase 4) renders this list with a validate button per item.

items.title: Monorepo access
items.how: The monorepo connector the build session uses. Nothing to fill in the app.

items.title: Production database read (connector)
items.how: The build session's read access to the production database (connector). Nothing to fill in the app.

items.title: Production connection string for pg_dump and psql apply
items.how: A production connection string on a machine with pg_dump 17, for the full dump before each apply. See docs/RUNBOOK-database.md step 3.

items.title: Staging project for rehearsals
items.how: Staging project access for the rehearsal (docs/RUNBOOK-database.md step 2).

items.title: Supabase security advisors and logs
items.how: Supabase security advisors. PLAT-06 computes the ERROR-level lints in SQL; the WARN ones need a Management API token later.

items.title: n8n base URL and API key for the app
items.how: n8n → Settings → n8n API → Create an API key. Save it here as one_n8n_key; the base URL is Settings → Hosts → n8n.

items.title: AWS Lightsail read access (n8n and Chatwoot server)
items.how: An AWS access key that can read the Lightsail instance running n8n and Chatwoot (read-only IAM policy), in the region of the server.

items.title: Chatwoot API token and account id
items.how: Chatwoot → Profile settings → Access token. Save it as one_chatwoot_token; the account id is in Settings → Chatwoot.

items.title: Vercel token for the eduwit team
items.how: Vercel → Account settings → Tokens → Create, scoped to the eduwit team, read access. Save it as one_vercel_token.

items.title: Spark base URL and b2c_internal_key (b2c.app_deploy_set)
items.how: Spark's own setting, filled in Spark: select b2c.app_deploy_set('https://spark.eduwit.in', '<B2C_INTERNAL_KEY from Vercel eduwit-spark>'). Eduwit One only reads it (PLAT-05).

items.title: B2B CRM host and a read API key (target: referrals-only)
items.how: The B2B CRM host (Settings → Hosts → b2b_app) and a referrals-only API key from the B2B CRM's Settings → API keys, saved as one_b2b_read_key.

items.title: Website public health endpoint
items.how: The website's address (Settings → Hosts → website). Its /api/health must answer.

items.title: Influencer portal host and health endpoint
items.how: The influencer portal's address (Settings → Hosts → influencer). Its /api/health must answer.

items.title: WhatsApp system-user token and WABA ids
items.how: Meta Business → System users → generate a token with whatsapp_business_management, saved as one_whatsapp_token; the WABA ids go in Settings → WhatsApp.

items.title: Meta ad-account read token
items.how: A Meta ad-account read token, saved as one_meta_token, for the spend tiles on the Marketing page.

items.title: Email provider for alerts (Resend)
items.how: Resend → API keys → Create (sending access, domain eduwit.in), saved as one_email_key. Validate sends a test email to the P1 inbox.

items.title: UptimeRobot read-only API key (external watchdog)
items.how: UptimeRobot → Integrations & API → Main API key (read-only is enough), saved as one_uptimerobot_key.

items.title: Anthropic API key for the AI layer (Claude only)
items.how: An Anthropic API key from the Claude Console (console.anthropic.com → API keys), saved here as one_anthropic_key. Claude only (owner, 24 Oct). The model and price of each tier are in Settings → AI; a model without a price is never called. Validate checks every tier's model, and the refusal fallback, with a free model lookup.

items.title: Sentry
items.how: Not used: monitoring is UptimeRobot (owner, 23 Oct).

items.title: P1 email inbox
items.how: Where P1 alerts go. Settings → Alerts → P1 email (owner only). Validate sends a test email.

items.title: Second P1 contact (60 min unacknowledged)
items.how: Who gets the 60-minute escalation. Settings → Alerts → second contact (owner only).

items.title: Developer email and GitHub handle
items.how: Who gets developer-tagged alerts (failing function, migration drift, privilege audit, Vercel build). Settings → Alerts → developer email.

items.title: Real test WhatsApp number in w2_trusted (is_test), with its own sender
items.how: Add the test number to w2_trusted with is_test = true (Witty's admin). Register it on a WhatsApp Business account Eduwit One may send from: Settings → test_identities: whatsapp_number (digits), whatsapp_phone_number_id (the sender's Graph id), witty_number (Witty's number, digits); paste the sender's token here. WhatsApp lets a business number send free text only within 24 hours of the other side's last message: Witty's replies keep that window open while T-WITTY-TURN runs; after a longer pause, send one message to the test number from Witty's side, or the send step fails.

items.title: Test mailbox that receives website codes and alert tests
items.how: A mailbox the tests can read, for enquiry and alert journeys. Settings → Test identities, key as one_test_mailbox_key.

items.title: Website preview URL with Turnstile test keys
items.how: A website preview deployment the tests may submit forms to. Settings → Test identities.

items.title: Spark user marked is_test_user (the test runner login can be it)
items.how: The test runner login (test_runner_user) covers this when it is a Spark admin with is_test_user; Spark gives test leads only to test users or admins.

items.title: B2B API key scoped to intake for test leads
items.how: A B2B CRM intake-only API key for test leads, saved as one_b2b_intake_key.

items.title: Test partner with a sandbox endpoint and an inbound secret
items.how: In the B2B CRM add a partner used only for tests, with test_endpoint set to a sandbox you control (https) and an inbound secret; it must be the only partner with a test_endpoint, or the push test refuses to run. Settings → test_identities.partner_slug; paste the inbound secret here.

items.title: Test creator with a known referral code
items.how: An influencer-portal creator marked as a test creator, with a referral code. Settings → Test identities.

items.title: Owner agreement to create and purge test rows in production
items.how: Agreed on 23 Oct: test rows may be created in production under the is_test conventions and purged nightly.

items.title: Eduwit logo and colour palette
items.how: The Eduwit logo and palette. An SVG wordmark would replace the PNGs (question Q6).

items.title: Expose schema one in the Supabase API (Project settings → Data API → Exposed schemas: add one)
items.how: Supabase → Project settings → Data API → Exposed schemas: add one, save. The app and this page read through it.

items.title: Eduwit One app environment: ONE_SUPABASE_URL, ONE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, ONE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY and ONE_INTERNAL_KEY in Vercel; the same key as Vault one_internal_key; one.settings.app.base_url; the sign-in redirect URL
items.how: Vercel project eduwit-one, Production env: ONE_SUPABASE_URL, ONE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, ONE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, ONE_INTERNAL_KEY (the same value as Vault one_internal_key). Then Settings → App → base_url = https://one.eduwit.in, and in Supabase → Authentication → URL configuration add https://one.eduwit.in/auth/callback.

items.title: UptimeRobot keyword monitor on https://one.eduwit.in/api/watchdog with an active alert contact (docs/RUNBOOK.md)
unblocks: notice when Supabase, pg_cron or Vercel is down
items.how: UptimeRobot keyword monitor on https://one.eduwit.in/api/watchdog for "ok":true, every 5 minutes, alert contact active (docs/RUNBOOK.md).

items.title: Test runner login: a B2B admin with two-factor and a Spark admin, used only by the synthetic tests
unblocks: the purge of B2B and Spark test leads
items.how: Create a Supabase user for the tests (for example tests@eduwit.in, agreed with the CRM owner, S-21). In the B2B CRM make it an admin with two-factor required and enrol a TOTP factor; in Spark make it an admin with is_test_user. Settings → test_identities.runner_email; paste its password and the TOTP secret (base32) here. Eduwit One signs in as it, with the one-time code, only to route, log and delete test leads (D-070).

items.title: A Spark journey in test mode for the nurture test
items.how: In Spark, create a journey in test mode whose first step queues a WhatsApp message; Settings → test_identities.spark_test_journey_id.
